topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was scrolling through the college's website the other day, just browsing through the admissions section, when I stumbled upon it. There, right under the header "Exemplary Application Essays," was my essay. I read through it, line by line, and every word felt just right. It was a moment of quiet reflection, but also a confirmation that all those hours of brainstorming, drafting, and revising were worthwhile. I found myself nodding along as I read, appreciating not just the outcome but the journey that got me there. It’s a good reminder that putting your best work forward can lead to unexpected recognitions.
